region: modern type theories (TTR, MTT, Ranta, DTS)
summary: Four shared constructions under explicit fixed-model and induced-noun assumptions. Positive/conditional image translation; MTT/Ranta/DTS constructive negative predication; Cooper preclusion-based negative witnesses imply exclusion but are not equated with fixed-model non-membership. Evidence-bearing discourse maps to a TTR record and uses a searched @ resolution.
